Dear Mr. Hunt,

Receiving your dispute regarding the account with our agency, Continental Receivables Corp, we acknowledge your assertion that you have a balance of $2,800.00 from an apartment that you recently paid in full. However, our records indicate that the current balance on the account ACC-906814 is $12,833.01.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to investigate your dispute. We will review the account to determine the accuracy of the balance and the status of the account. As per Kentucky state law, we must also provide you with a written validation of the debt, which we will do if our investigation confirms the debt's validity.

We will investigate the matter and provide you with a written response regarding the findings. If our investigation confirms that the debt is valid, we will provide you with a written validation of the debt, which will include the original creditor's name, the amount of the debt, and the date the debt was incurred.

Please note that our investigation may take some time, and we appreciate your patience in this matter. You have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe our findings are incorrect.

Sincerely,

Continental Receivables Corp
